purpose: Cover the DEFINE stage-gate check functions D1..D8 (AC-17401-1..8) with unit tests over hand-built TreeModel and ledger fixtures.
title: Stage gates D1..D8 check functions

testCases.description: Every check function returns { stage, gate, state, checks[] } and every entry in checks[] is { name, ok, over: 'delta'|'tree', pass, total, failing }; failing is empty when ok is true.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates: every check function returns the section 2.4 shape

testCases.description: Blocking stages fold to failing on any check.ok false; warn-with-ack stages (D3, D5, D6) also fold to failing on any check.ok false unless freeze.gates[<gate>].state === 'acknowledged' AND at.hash === currentTreeHash.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates: warn-with-ack fold honours freeze.gates acknowledgement at the current hash

testCases.description: notApplicable is decided per stage per section 3.2: D2 with no statement of a resolving kind and no REQ/PRD/TAD in scope; D3 with no TAC and no shaped REQ in scope; D5 with no REQ in scope; D7 with no open decisions and profile.skipReviewFor 'singleDocument' and one-document delta.

checkD4Stories enforces every REQ has US, every US has testable AC + failure AC (parsed by [failure] prefix or opt-out with baselineKey 'defineD4:failure') + must-not AC (or opt-out with 'defineD4:mustNot'), tacIds non-empty and resolving, no TODO placeholder in AC.description.
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates: D4 floors and per-class opt-outs

testCases.description: checkD3Shapes runs only the cheap data-backed checks: every TAC in scope has at least one interface, and every interface kind is in the closed vocabulary. Unknown kinds show up in failing[].
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates: D3 interface presence and kind vocabulary

testCases.description: checkD5Crosscut checks TAD.securityArchitecture presence when any REQ has shape 'auth' or 'httpApi'; TAD.operationalConcerns when any AC has '[deployed]' marker; no dangling 'open' concerns on in-scope REQs.
checkD6Consistency asserts validateErrors is empty tree-wide and probeOpenCount is zero; the richer scans are named seams (0.30).
testCases.testPointer: test/query/gates.test.js::gates: D6 consistency validate + probe count

testCases.description: checkD8Freeze asserts prior stages passed/acknowledged, every AC owned by exactly one FBS, computeQueue nextActionable not null, validateErrors empty.
